home.para.1: SOURCE ry is the community for Information and Communication Technology (ICT) students at Tampere University of Applied Sciences (TAMK), bringing together future ICT professionals, student life, and career opportunities. We foster a strong sense of community, build valuable networks, and connect students with companies across the industry.
home.para.2: Throughout the year, we organize a diverse range of events, from casual sauna evenings and our popular TiTeLAN events to company visits, expert talks, and networking events. We actively collaborate with Tamko, TIRO ry, other student organizations, and our corporate partners.
home.para.3: Membership is open to all TAMK students, regardless of their degree programme.

partners.futurice.para.1: Futurice is a pioneer in digital transformation. We help organizations leverage technology, creativity, and agile ways of working to transform their businesses, develop their services, and create sustainable competitive advantage.
partners.kaijakka.para.1: The best karaoke in Tampere every day of the week! Karaoke, nightclub, sauna, and terrace.
partners.kaijakka.para.2: Restaurant Kaijakka is a long-standing karaoke venue and a full-scale nightclub located in the heart of Tampere, on the waterfront of Laukontori Square. Kaijakka’s versatile facilities are ideal for a wide range of events, including celebrations, corporate functions, birthday parties, bachelor and bachelorette parties, and other private occasions.
partners.netum.para.1: Netum’s roots are firmly grounded in Finland and in high-quality technological expertise. We aim to be an enabler of change and responsible digital development for our customers, their most trusted digital partner, and the most desirable workplace in the industry.
partners.nokia.para.1: Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era, providing the critical network infrastructure the world relies on.
partners.nokia.para.2: Open yourself to start your career with Nokia. We’re looking for unique minds, and we hire around 500 trainees annually in Finland. Apply to our open positions via www.nokia.com/careers.
partners.reaktor.para.1: Reaktor is a Finnish globally operating technology company that designs, builds and sells software products and digital solutions that it considers pioneering.
